text.en:
1. (1) This Order may be cited as the Accountants (Amendment
of First Schedule) (No. 2) Order 1986.

(2) Paragraphs (b), (c), (d) and (e) of Part I of the First
Schedule to the Accountants Act 1967, as introduced into the Act
by the amendments embodied in paragraph 2 of this Order, shall
be deemed to have come into force on the Ist January 1975,
the 1st March 1978, the 1st January 1981 and the Ist January
1983 respectively.

2. The Accountants Act 1967 is amended by substituting for
Part I of, the First Schedule the following Part I:

-                                        Part I

(a). the final examination of the Malaysian Institute of
Accountants or, in the national language, ‘peperiksaan
akhir Institut Akauntan Malaysia'; or

(b) the final examination of the University of Malaya for the
Diploma in Accounting or, in the national language,
"peperiksaan akhir Universiti Malaya untuk Diploma
Perakaunan'; or

(c) the final examination of the University of Malaya for the
Degree of Bachelor of Accounting or, in the national
language, ‘peperiksaan akhir Universiti Malaya untuk
Ijazah Sarjanamuda Perakaunan'; or

(d) the final examination of Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia
for the Degree of Bachelor of Accounting (Honours) or,
in the national language, ‘peperiksaan akhir Universiti
Kebangsaan Malaysia untuk ljazah Sarjanamuda Per-
akaunan (Kepujian); or

AKTA EKSAIS 1976

PERATURAN-PERATURAN EKSAIS (LEMBAGA [PBLBSEN)
(PINDAAN) 1986

Pada menjalankan kuasa-kuasa yang diberi oleh seksyen 85 Akta
Eksais 1976, Menteri membuat peraturan-peraturan yang berikut:

1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-
Peraturan Eksais (Lembaga Pelesen) (Pindaan) 1986 dan hendak-
lah mula berkuatkuasa pada 20hb Februari 1986.

2. Peraturan 18 Peraturan-Peraturan Eksais (Lembaga Pelesen)
1977 adalah dipinda dengan menggantikannya dengan peraturan 18
baru yang berikut:

Mengeluar- 18. Lesen-lesen boleh dikeluarkan oleh seorang
| pegawai kanan eksais, atau Pegawai Daerah, atau
Setiausaha Kerajaan Negeri atau Datuk Bandar meng-

ikut arahan-arahan Lembaga.".

EXCISE ACT 1976
ExcIsE (LICENSING BOARDS) (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 1986

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 85 of the Excise Act
1976, the Minister makes the following regulations :

1. These regulations may be cited as the Excise (Licensing
Boards) (Amendment) Regulations 1986 and shall come into force
on the 20th February 1986.

2. Regulation 18 of the Excise (Lecensing Boards) Regulations
1977 is amended by substituting therefor the following new regu-
lation 18:

hoe 18. Licences may in accordance with the directions of
the Board be issued by a senior officer of excise, or
Diana Officer, or State Secretary or Commissioner of
a City.".

Diperbuat pada 23hb Januari 1986.

Made the 23rd January 1986.
(KE. HE. (20) 511/01-1; Perb. PN. (PU?) 337 Pt. IIL)

IDAIM BIN ZAINUDDIN,
Menteri Kewangan
Minister of Finance
